WE'RE MAKING PROGRESS! The server now:
1. Starts up successfully
2. Listens on port 3000
3. Serves assets from /world-assets

The shutdown error is probably also due to missing dependencies but that's on exit. Let me check the port and then stabilize this.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'ENDOFSCRIPT'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Start server in background with pm2
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && SUPABASE_URL=x SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=x pm2 delete areloria 2>/dev/null; SUPABASE_URL=x SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=x pm2 start npx --name areloria -- run tsx src/index.ts 2>&1")
print("PM2 start:", stdout.read().decode())

# Wait and check
import time
time.sleep(5)

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 status 2>&1")
print("\nStatus:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check port 3000
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep 3000 || ss -tlnp | grep 3000")
print("\nPort 3000:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
ENDOFSCRIPT
